- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **34** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c58008187fb14259cae52461aff9971a1b4b15e9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `df74fd4b6d29abe0778921b5577ebf62762bcde6` — the merge of head `a1107d3c65641be8cbc9650ff48eb8466a776741` into base `c58008187fb14259cae52461aff9971a1b4b15e9`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin df74fd4b6d29abe0778921b5577ebf62762bcde6 && git checkout df74fd4b6d29abe0778921b5577ebf62762bcde6
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c58008187fb14259cae52461aff9971a1b4b15e9 a1107d3c65641be8cbc9650ff48eb8466a776741 && git checkout -B drift-repro c58008187fb14259cae52461aff9971a1b4b15e9 && git merge --no-ff a1107d3c65641be8cbc9650ff48eb8466a776741

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c58008187fb14259cae52461aff9971a1b4b15e9
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c58008187fb14259cae52461aff9971a1b4b15e9` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a1107d3c65641be8cbc9650ff48eb8466a776741`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/objectql/src/registry-extension-plural-label.test.ts, packages/objectql/src/registry.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-object-extension-plural-label.test.ts, scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json + packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts, docs/adr/0029-kernel-object-ownership-and-platform-objects-decomposition.md, docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md, packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts, packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts, examples/app-showcase/src/data/extensions/account.extension.ts, examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts, skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, AGENTS.md

Inputs read: card #30391 (body, triage 6655169453, claim 6656144660, os-dev-report 6657882269), PR #30459 body and file list, the net diff against `main` (merge-base `1013ef11`; no commit on `origin/main` since touches a PR path), and the check-runs on the head. Read-only: nothing built, run or re-run.

Check-runs on the head as they stand: every completed run is `success` or `skipped` (Build Core, Build Docs, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Spec property liveness, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, the three scoped lints, Type Check · consumer / debt ledger / source gates, Test Core (7/8), Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Live E2E UI, Check Documentation Links, Flag docs affected, Auto Label, filter). Still `in_progress` at write time: Test Core (1/8), (2/8), (3/8), (4/8), (5/8), (6/8), (8/8) and Type Check · workspace. No run has failed. A red among the in-progress runs reopens this record.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set: unchanged — right.** `packages/spec` is untouched; `ObjectExtensionSchema` (`object.zod.ts`) still accepts `label` and `pluralLabel` as independent optional strings, and nothing an author writes is refused or newly accepted. `Metadata-protocol: semantic` is the right kind: what an extension's `label` without `pluralLabel` means to the served object changed.
- **Public surface: no exported symbol moves — right.** `withoutStaleObjectPlural`, `pairTranslationBundleOfBase` and `nonEmptyText` are module-private in `meta-item-read-gate.ts` (no `+export` in the diff; `packages/rest/src/index.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/index.ts` untouched). `pairTranslationBundleOf` keeps its signature and now delegates its second question to the new private helper; its `undefined`-on-every-uncertainty rule is preserved.
- **Served-value change 1 — the fold (`mergeObjectDefinitions`) — right.** An applied `label` (not yielded under ADR-0029 D9.2a) that differs from the running label, with `extension.pluralLabel === undefined` and no tenant-authored plural, deletes `merged.pluralLabel` before writing the label. `merged` is a spread copy, so the base definition and `getPackagedObjectBase` (the owner contributor's body) keep the owner's plural, which the translators compare against. Idempotent over an already-folded base: the refold reads the folded label as tenant-diverged and yields on `label`, so the block is skipped and the plural stays absent. Two extenders resolve by priority as the scalars always did (a later rename with no plural drops an earlier extender's plural; a later plural lands over an earlier rename). The rule is generic over every `extend` contributor (code `objectExtensions` and `.custom` items alike), which is right: the spec has one `ObjectExtensionSchema` and the registry one merge.
- **Served-value change 2 — `/meta/object` read (`withoutStaleObjectPlural`) — right.** Applied where the served object carries no non-empty plural, the packaged base declares one, and the served `label` differs from the packaged `label`. Then the pair bundle of the packaged base's `_packageId` is read (memoised per base for the list, the same key space `pairTranslationBundleOf` uses, since both memoise `getPairTranslationBundle(basePackageId)`), the pair's `objects.NAME.pluralLabel` is read through the spec's own `translateMetadataDocument` over the pair bundle alone, and otherwise the catalog's plural is removed (no key when the input had none; the input's own value when it had a key). Every other object returns `translated` by reference, and the pair is read only when the rule fires. With no protocol or no packaged base the translator's answer stands, matching the gate's existing degradation rule.
- **Both reads, both transports — covered.** `translateMetaList` is the last step of the list chain on `RestServer.translateMetaItems` and on the runtime dispatcher's `translateList` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`); `translateMetaDocument` is called by `RestServer.translateMetaItem` and, through `translateMetaEnvelope`, by the runtime dispatcher's `translateEnvelope`. The new step sits inside both exported functions, after the view branch, so neither transport can skip it. `p` and `packagedBase` are in scope in the PR-head `translateMetaDocument`.
- **Tenant-authored plural — kept, on both halves.** Fold: `!yields('pluralLabel')` guards the delete, and a tenant-authored `label` makes the whole rename yield (pinned). Read: a served object carrying a non-empty `pluralLabel` returns untouched, so a tenant's `To-dos` survives and translates under the existing D9.2a comparison. A tenant rename that kept the old plural is untouched, as the PR says. The D9.2a honest edge (an overlay that round-tripped the extender's rename with the base plural frozen in) keeps serving that plural; that is the ADR's recorded cost, not this PR's.
- **`scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` (+5) — right, named as out-of-surface.** One ledger row for the new rest pin's `findOne` double, in the shape and alphabetical slot of its neighbours, written by `check-engine-double-contract --write` and required by that gate (precedent PR #30353). Generated output, not reviewed further; it is the gate's own record of the test the diff adds.
- **Tests — pin what the change claims.** The rest pin boots a real `SchemaRegistry`, protocol and `RestServer`, reads both `/meta/object` routes in `en` and `zh-CN`, measures the reference (`crm_note`, no plural) on the same boot, and pins the pair's plural first, a pair row that translates only `label` not reviving the base plural, and the controls (plural set, plural only, neither, repeated label, untouched object). The objectql pin covers the fold's rules, including D9.2a yields and two-extender order.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/30391-extension-rename-drops-stale-plural.md`: `@objectstack/objectql: minor`, `@objectstack/rest: minor`. AGENTS.md § Post-Task Checklist 3: a protocol kind other than `none` takes at least `minor` on a package the diff moves; `Metadata-protocol: semantic` is such a kind, and both packages move. Level matches.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` — the arm fits: no exported member or accepted value moves, and a served value is narrowed (a `pluralLabel` key stops being served where it was). The arm is BREAKING by rule; the changeset carries the `BREAKING` banner, the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` with its reason, and both declaration lines line-initial. Nothing an author can write is removed or renamed, so no FROM-to-TO migration is owed; the body's "declare `pluralLabel` beside `label`" is a remedy for a cosmetic loss, not a rewrite prescription. `Check Changeset`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` are green on the head.
- The PR body carries the same two lines, identically.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Ledger outside the order's surface** — answered above: generated by the gate, shape-checked, precedent recorded. Accepted.
2. **Clause-② corrected from provisional `no` to `no (narrowing)`** — right; the diff moves an answered shape for every label-only extension, the showcase's `showcase_account` included.
3. **PR assign/review skipped per the order** — procedural; no finding.
4. **Fold rule generic over every extender** — right; one schema, one merge (see ①).
5. **`open_questions`: land a BREAKING served-value narrowing for a p2 label fix (A merge as declared / B add `pluralLabel` to the showcase's own extension in a follow-up)** — escalated to the maintainer, whose word the narrowing requires: this record judges the contract, not the merge. On the design the dev's recommendation holds (A, with B as a small examples follow-up). On B: `examples/app-showcase/src/data/extensions/account.extension.ts` renames `showcase_account` to `Account (Success Overlay)` with no plural, and the showcase's own bundle (`examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts`) translates the base's plural as `Accounts` / `客户`; after this PR the list title reads the label in both locales (the nav entry keeps its own `label: 'Accounts'`). **Should-fix (follow-up, outside the surface):** add `pluralLabel` to that extension.
6. **Skills-docs follow-up flag** — confirmed: `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` line 349 says "an extension can add but never remove", which this PR makes false for the plural scalar. `skills/**` is outside the dev's surface. **Should-fix (follow-up card):** amend the sentence with the exception. The same follow-up should carry a one-line D9.2a note in ADR-0029, whose D9.2 rationale states that `mergeObjectDefinitions` "has no expression for removal at all"; that argument (about `fields`) still holds, but the sentence is now imprecise for `pluralLabel`. `docs/adr/**` is outside the surface; no ADR decision moves.
7. **`form-routes.ts` not measured (out_of_scope_findings 2 / acceptance note 3)** — the dev calls it "outside this change's surface"; it is in `packages/rest/src/**`, which the order names. The public form's object schema is built as `{ name, label, fields }` and translated through `translateMetadataDocument('object', …, { packagedBase })` with no post-step, so for a renamed object the catalog's plural can still be served on that payload. The form payload never carried the served plural and the card is about list titles, so this is not a defect of the card's fix. **Should-fix (seat carrier, as the dev flagged):** measure it and either apply `withoutStaleObjectPlural` there or record why the form's plural has no reader.
8. **out_of_scope_findings 1 (an object's served `label` reads no pair translation; PR #30353 left objects out of `pairBundle`)** — pre-existing, noted by the seat; not widened here. The plural now reads the pair while the label does not, which the dev records honestly as "two names still" for a pair translating both strings. Carrier: seat.
9. **Served-tier** — `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` on body and changeset, no published schema or governed path in the committed tree: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, narrowing face, as asked.

### ④ Design judgment

**Does the narrowing take a declared capability away at the consumer, or make the spec's own refusal real?** Read against `main`:

- `ObjectExtensionSchema` declares `label` as "Override label for the extended object" and `pluralLabel` as "Override plural label for the extended object", both optional, and declares nothing about the base's plural under a label-only override. `ObjectSchema.pluralLabel` is optional, so "an object with no plural" is a shape the spec already admits, and the Console's `objectPluralLabel` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts`) titles such a list by the translated plural, else the declared plural, else the label. No published text promises that a renamed object keeps serving the base's plural; the only thing serving it was last-writer-wins on a key the extension never wrote.
- ADR-0029 D9.2a: an extender's scalar yields to a tenant-diverged base; the PR applies the same yield to its delete and to the label that triggers it. ADR-0146 D10: an object is extended, never replaced; the base declaration and `getPackagedObjectBase` are untouched, only the fold's served body changes. Neither ADR declares the capability being narrowed.
- The spec translator (`translateObject`, `i18n-resolver.ts`): `catalog ?? authored` per scalar, with the catalog yielding only where the served scalar provably diverged from `packagedBase`, and an absent scalar counting as "no opinion" by the ruling's conservative edges. For a renamed object with no plural that edge serves `objects.NAME.pluralLabel`, which is the base package's translation of a plural the object no longer carries; the `en` catalog repeats the source, so `en` is affected too. The spec's rule is that the deployment catalog translates the base's text; serving it on a scalar the served object does not carry is an invented value, the same shape as the view `label` the gate already removes (`withoutInventedViewLabel`, #23967). The PR follows that precedent, keeps the spec's lookup intact, and lets the owner's `.custom` pair rank first under the ruled label order (ruling record 6631250894, cited in the code and in `labelCatalogs`). So the narrowing corrects a served value the spec does not promise. It takes no declared capability away: an author who wants a plural for the new name declares `pluralLabel`, which the spec always offered, and a pair can save `objects.NAME.pluralLabel`.
- One asymmetry, noted and judged sound: an unrenamed object with no declared plural but a catalog plural entry still receives the catalog's plural; the renamed object does not. That is the point of the rule (the catalog entry translates the old plural), though "served as an object that declares no `pluralLabel`" in the PR and changeset is strictly "as one that declares no plural and has no catalog plural for the new name". Prose only; no fix owed.

**Trying to break it:**

- Fold: compared against the running `merged.label`, not the owner's, so extender order is honoured; a repeated label renames nothing; a base with no plural makes the delete a no-op; the refold yields (idempotence pinned). A lower-priority extender's plural-only contribution is dropped by a higher-priority rename without a plural; consistent with "the plural is the plural of the running label" and pinned.
- Read: the input to the comparison is the pre-translation served document, so translations never confuse the label test; `packaged._packageId` comes from the owner contributor (pinned); the memo key space is `basePackageId` in both helpers, so no collision; the pair lookup runs along the i18n fallback chain as `labelCatalogs` does for every pair string; with `pluralLabel: ''` on the input the served value becomes `''` where the catalog's plural was served before, a degenerate authoring no scenario reaches. With the protocol unreachable the old answer stands, by the gate's stated rule.
- A tenant overlay that renamed the label and removed the plural key is now served with none where the catalog's base plural was served; the tenant authored the absence, so this is the reference shape, not a lost value.

No must-fix. Should-fix: items 5, 6 and 7 of ③ (showcase extension plural; Skills sentence plus ADR-0029 D9.2a note; `form-routes.ts` measured and aligned or recorded), each a follow-up or seat carrier, none a defect in the diff's own claims.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-ktw7m9`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：某个包的扩展只改了对象的 `label`、没写 `pluralLabel` 时，对象不再返回基础包的旧复数，也不再返回旧复数的译文。如果改名的配对包里有复数译文，就返回那份译文；没有就不返回复数，界面回落到新单数名。租户自己写的复数照旧保留。
- 为什么改：改了名的对象在侧栏和列表标题里仍显示旧复数，一个对象出现两个名字；在中文下，旧复数还会被译成旧词。
- 风险与回滚：这是一次已返回值的收窄（BREAKING），所有只改 label 的扩展都会少返回 `pluralLabel`。showcase 自带的 `showcase_account` 就在其中，它的列表标题会变成单数名，补复数的跟进卡是 #30465。不涉及数据迁移，回滚只需撤掉本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 里的 `mergeObjectDefinitions` 标量覆盖段；`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` 里的 `withoutStaleObjectPlural`，以及它在列表读和单条读上的两处调用。
- 两分钟验证：运行 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-object-extension-plural-label.test.ts`，预期 11 条全绿；在修复前的代码上有 4 条是红的。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

席位意见：同意落地。这次收窄改的是一个 spec 并未承诺的返回值，没有拿掉任何已声明的能力。达档合同复核 PASS（6658126879），钉住 head `a1107d3c6`。路径不触受治理面，规模 +536/−8，没有超过人工合并门槛。

## 席位核对

Head `a1107d3c65641be8cbc9650ff48eb8466a776741` · 2026-11-05T13:49Z

- **形态:** the PR matches the order. The fold drops the stale plural, and the read gate serves the pair translation or no plural. Tenant plurals are kept by D9.2a yields on both halves. The PR does not edit spec or ADR files.
- **前提实测:** before the fix, the fold kept the base plural and the translator fell back to the catalog plural. The dev measured this, and both ablations go red.
- **门禁 check-runs:** every check on `a1107d3c6` is green or skipped (38 success, 12 skipped, 0 failed). `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 30459` reports NOT governed.
- **接受的偏差:** a generated row in `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` (the #30353 precedent). For `form-routes.ts`, the dev measured no reader of the payload's plural, so it is left unchanged.
- **范围外去向 + `Skills-docs:`:** #30465 (showcase plural); #30466 (the skills sentence and the ADR-0029 D9.2 wording, Tier H). The body now reads `Skills-docs: follow-up #30466`.
- **落地条款:** non-governed, and the narrowing passed contract review at tier. Under pm-dispatch the seat lands it (maintainer 13:47Z: "技能不需要我审核的不应该等我"): `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`, then a landing comment on #30391 after merge.
